title: The Minefield Harvest
logline: Desperate scrappers are harvesting unexploded ordnance from a dead system's minefield to sell as raw cuprite, and a frantic engineer needs it stopped before someone blows up the local relay.

roles.description: Constantly calculating blast radii in their head, completely stressed out.
Cheerful, reckless, views every live bomb as a paycheck.
A dense asteroid field littered with dormant stealth mines.
A heavily modified hauler, currently dragging a live torpedo.
The corporate buyer turning a blind eye to the source of the cuprite.

public_situation: A massive influx of cheap, high-grade cuprite has flooded the market, supposedly mined from the dangerous {role:minefield_belt}.
private_truth: The scrappers are disarming the old minefield to harvest the cuprite in the detonators. They don't realize the mines are networked, and removing too many will trigger a cascade failure.

beats.public_change: A distant explosion in the belt shakes the local relay station.

missions.reason: The scrapper hires the pilot to deliver their latest haul of cuprite to the relay's buying office.
missions.private_fact: The cuprite still has active military-grade blasting caps attached to it.

beats.public_change: The engineer discovers the blasting caps and triggers a station-wide panic.

missions.reason: The engineer asks the pilot to scan the minefield to find the master control buoy.
missions.private_fact: The scan reveals the scrappers are already towing the buoy away.

beats.public_change: The minefield's fail-deadly network begins arming the remaining warheads.

missions.reason: The engineer pays the pilot to destroy the scrapper's tug before it can jump away with the control buoy.
missions.private_fact: The scrapper hails the pilot, offering to split the massive corporate payout if the pilot escorts them out of the system instead.

resolutions.summary: The control buoy is recovered and the minefield is safed. The engineer is relieved, and the scrapper market crashes.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot blew up a greedy scrapper to stop an old minefield from going critical.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the scrapper's offer.
resolutions.summary: The scrapper escapes with the buoy. The minefield detonates, heavily damaging the relay and severing communications.
The scrapper mishandles the buoy. The entire field goes up, destroying the tug and the relay.

loose_threads.detail: The mining syndicate was paying for the cuprite using a massive private investment bank escrow account.
The supposedly ancient mines were running a software patch dated only three months ago.

radio_hooks: Cuprite prices plummet as mysterious new source floods the market.

voice_direction.frantic_engineer: Fast, breathless, constantly interrupting themselves with math.
voice_direction.reckless_scrapper: Cheerful, unbothered, speaks too fast without pausing for breath.
